Commentary: Blessing Muzarabani [2.0-0-28-1] is back into the attack

Blessing Muzarabani to Azmatullah Omarzai, no run, short of length and hard length on off, Azmatullah Omarzai goes on the back foot to defend to the right of backward point. Sent back by Ibrahim Zadran

Blessing Muzarabani to Azmatullah Omarzai, 2 runs, short of length and hard length again, on middle-stump, Azmatullah Omarzai gets forward to pull, doesn't time it but manages to clear mid-wicket who prevents the boundary

Blessing Muzarabani to Azmatullah Omarzai, no run, that sums up Zimbabwe's performance today. Blessing Muzarabani is aghast. The camera pans to Raza who is chewing his gum and just looks serious. Dropped by Tadiwanashe Marumani. Length delivery on middle, Azmatullah Omarzai backs away to loft, the thick outside edge and Marumani initally wanted to reverse-cup that, then as it comes to him, he changes his mind and goes the conventional way. Drops it. Still has a chance at the rebound, but can't grab that. Muzarabani lets out his emotions as he's not happy at all. Raza too the same, but he does well not to show it on camera
Blessing Muzarabani to Azmatullah Omarzai, 1 run, short of length outside off, Azmatullah Omarzai goes on the back foot and opens the face of the bat to run it down to third man
Blessing Muzarabani to Ibrahim Zadran, no run, back of a length on middle, tucks up Ibrahim Zadran who goes on the back foot and turns it to mid-wicket
Blessing Muzarabani to Ibrahim Zadran, no run, short of length and tight on off, no room at all, Ibrahim Zadran defends it back and Blessing Muzarabani sticks out a left hand to stop it
Vincent Masekesa, right-arm leg break, comes into the attack

Vincent Masekesa to Azmatullah Omarzai, SIX, Azmatullah Omarzai ends things with a big six. It's a half-tracker on middle-stump, Omarzai goes on the back foot and pulls, way back over wide long-on. Flies into the top-tier and into the crowd. Omarzai goes to Ibrahim Zadran to pat him and then the post-match formalities begin

20:51 Local Time, 16:51 GMT, 22:21 IST: A thrashing this as Afghanistan clean-sweep Zimbabwe. Smiles from Azmatullah Omarzai and Ibrahim Zadran as they chat while Sikandar Raza just puts his head down and walks off. He will vent it out in the post-match presentation. That's for sure. I will be keenly listening to what he says. This was an easy chase once Zimbabwe folded for 79. Mohammad Akram started in a hurry and wanted to end this very early but after a hat-trick of fours, he fell to Muzarabani in the opening over. Masuku struck twice in one over to bring some cheer for his side but the eventual result was never in doubt. The whole game lasted 22.4 overs and if there was one moment which summed up Zimbabwe's fortunes tonight, then it was Tadiwanashe Marumani's drop of Omarzai and the subsequent reactions from Muzarabani and Raza. Stay tuned for the post-match stuff....

Tarakhail 2/2: [On the inspiration behind his unusual bowling action, compared with Lasith Malinga and Shaun Tait] If I talk about that, I have also followed fast bowlers. It is my natural action. My coaches have always told me during practice that I should not make changes to it. They tell me that the action I have naturally is very good. So that is the reason. There is nothing particularly special behind it.

Ibrahim Zadran | Afghanistan captain 1/2: [On Afghanistan's overall performance and winning the T20I series against Zimbabwe] Very good series. I'm so happy, you know, with the overall performance and the energy the guys put in. In each and every game, they have shown discipline. That's why, you know, we won three in a row. They have played very good cricket. [On whether he felt pressure as captain, given Afghanistan's previous record of never losing a series to Zimbabwe] To be honest, I heard about it, but I didn't think about it. I was just thinking that we would try to go with a positive mindset and give 100 percent. Then we cannot think about the result. What we can think about is only the process, which is, you know, in our hands. This is what we were doing in every game, and yeah, we just delivered that. And every game, we got the result.
Ibrahim Zadran is presented the winning trophy and he is all smiles. Then he gives it to Abdullah Tarakhail as the entire Afghanistan contingent pose as a group for the cameras.

A whitewash by Afghanistan and Zimbabwe have a lot of things to ponder as we move to the Tests next. That starts on the 5th of November in Sharjah. Will a change of format bring a change in fortunes for Zimbabwe? We will wait and see. We will be there nice and early for the 1st Test. Do join us then. For now that's it from all of us here.
